replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
There isn't anything that stands out on it from the rest, it's really, really small, I don't really think it's up to standards at all.
Monument islands are poor and too far away, given the size of the map it would be chaotic and troublesome to get to one.
The shape of the islands is basically the same one and there is not very much elegance on it aside from the leaves with wooden slabs on them, detail that I consider to be very impressive.
If this is an official release, you submitted it in the wrong part of the forums, the right part being under the 'Map Releases' section.
Anyways, so far it's a deny from my part, the map lacks a lot: creativity, space, originality. There's not really much to it that looks appealing at all, I suggest you re-work it.
Best of luck, sir.

Creativity: 1/5
Gameplay: 2/5
Aesthetics: 2/5
